text:
Alex H: Hey team — quick personal update: Morgan and I quietly eloped last month! We wanted to tell people in person but figured we should share here too 🥲💍. Also, after a wild week, I got promoted to Staff SWE. Tiny celebration? :tada:
Morgan P: ❤️ We kept it small but we’re so happy. No big pics yet (camera batteries died lol) but will bring some treats for the office.
Lina: WHAT!! 🎉 Huge congrats to both of you!! So many celebrations in one thread. When do we get cake?
Sam: Double congrats!! Staff SWE + married — Alex, you’re doing too much at once, chill :) I can bring donuts.
Priya: Aww congrats both of you!!! I’ll bring samosas or a tray of mango lassi if that helps.
Jamal: I’ll order a sheet cake — vanilla with chocolate frosting? Or do you want something specific? Congrats Alex and Morgan :tada::tada:
Alex H: Love the offers — thank you!! Cake sounds perfect. Thinking Wednesday 3/25 around 4pm in the big kitchen? Open to after-work drinks instead if people prefer.
Maya: Poll via reactions: 🥐 = morning donuts, 🍰 = cake at 4pm, 🍻 = after-work drinks. React to pick.
Lina: 🍰
Sam: 🍻
Priya: 🍰
Jamal: 🍰
Morgan P: No strong preference — cake at 4 works best for us so folks can swing by between meetings.
Alex H: If anyone wants to help coordinate sign-ups (drinks, utensils, balloons?), drop a quick note here. I’ll try to stay out of the planning so it’s a surprise-ish :sweat_smile:
Priya: I can take drinks + cups.
Maya: I’ll handle balloons and a tiny sign.
Sam: I can cover coffee/donuts if we need a fallback morning option.
Lina: I’ll take photos at the thing and bring a little card for both of you.
Jamal: Cake ordered. Will post ETA in #kitchen when it’s arriving.
Alex H: You’re all the best — seriously grateful. See you Wednesday 4pm (cake squad assembled) :heart:
Morgan P: Thank you team! We owe you celebratory snacks forever :grin:
